items.title: AppLovin in talks to acquire ad-tech peer Criteo, Reuters reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Applovin Corp (NASDAQ:APP) is among the prospective buyers in discussions to acquire smaller Paris-based advertising technology peer Criteo Sa ADR (NASDAQ:CRTO), according to a Reuters report citing two people familiar with the matter. The potential deal highlights ongoing consolidation across the digital advertising sector as larger software platforms look to expand their reach.
